messages:
alex: Heads-up — customer ACME (EU tenant) opened ticket #78912. They called out repeated 504s on our async delete API (/v1/tenants/:id/delete) and need GDPR deletion evidence. They specifically want a single bundle that shows: API ingress, job enqueue, storage object removal, and any KMS/HSM handshake logs for the envelope keys. Region: eu-west-1. Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. Delete submitted: 2025-11-02T14:23:10Z. Can SRE/KMS help collect and package?

maria: I can pull the request flow and job trace. Do they need raw HSM logs or a redacted audit trail? Raw HSM logs are sensitive and require security sign-off. :thinking_face:

oleg: We cannot share raw HSM key material. We can export KMS audit events (key usage, Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign calls) and the handshake status from the HSM gateway. That should satisfy most controllers. If they insist on raw syslogs we need legal & security approval.

alex: Good to know. They asked for chain-of-custody style evidence — timestamps, request IDs, and who/what service acted. Redacted KMS audit + HSM handshake status is fine. Also they asked that the bundle shows propagation across our subsystems (api -> queue -> storage).

jordan: I'll chime in with the customer expectations — they want "proof of deletion" for their DPA audit. Prefer a single TLS-protected bundle and a short narrative timeline. They gave a 3-day SLA to respond.

maria: Repro plan for SRE to generate logs: 1) query api-gateway logs for req_0a1b2c3d 2) pull job-id from delete worker logs 3) find storage delete markers (S3) and object lifecycle entries 4) export KMS audit events for the envelope key ID referenced. Commands below.

maria: ```
# api gateway
jq -r '.request_id=="req_0a1b2c3d"' /var/log/api-gateway/2025-11-02.log
# worker
grep req_0a1b2c3d /var/log/delete-worker/*.log | sed -n '1,200p'
# storage
aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket redwood-tenant-eu --prefix tenants/ACME/ --query "Versions[?contains(Key,'file') || contains(Key,'object') ]"
# kms audit (internal)
redwood-kms-audit export --key-id  key_eu_0a1b --from 2025-11-02T14:00:00Z --to 2025-11-02T15:00:00Z --out acme-kms-events.json
```

oleg: For the HSM gateway we can export the handshake summary (NOT raw HSM syslog). Use the internal endpoint: `/internal/hsm/handshake-summary?key=key_eu_0a1b&from=...`. Output is JSON with fields: handshake_id, status, client_cert_fingerprint, timestamp. I'll run it and redact cert fingerprints.

oleg: Note: if the customer wants proof that the envelope key was used to decrypt before deletion we can show the KMS Decrypt event for that key id and the worker's request id correlation. We cannot show plaintext or key material.

sophie: Compliance note: when packaging evidence for EU controllers, include: exact UTC timestamps, hashes (SHA256) of exported files for integrity, an explanation of redactions, and statement of what we cannot provide for security reasons. Also include retention policy references: KMS audit logs retained 90 days, object delete markers retained 30 days.

alex: Thanks Sophie. Maria — can you pull the timeline and assemble the bundle? Oleg — please run the handshake-summary and attach the exported events. Jordan — I'll prepare the customer-facing narrative.

maria: I'll start. Quick status: API gateway shows ingress at 2025-11-02T14:23:10. Worker enqueued job id job_55b7 and started processing at 14:23:12 on node delete-03. Worker log snippet: ```
[2025-11-02T14:23:12Z] INFO job_55b7 started req=req_0a1b2c3d tenant=ACME user=ops@acme.com
[2025-11-02T14:23:13Z] INFO job_55b7 calling KMS decrypt key=key_eu_0a1b session=xyz
[2025-11-02T14:23:14Z] INFO job_55b7 delete s3://redwood-tenant-eu/tenants/ACME/object/12345
[2025-11-02T14:23:15Z] INFO job_55b7 completed status=deleted
```

oleg: HSM handshake summary (redacted) returned: ```
{"handshake_id":"hs_9f8a","status":"SUCCESS","timestamp":"2025-11-02T14:23:13Z","client":"delete-03","notes":"no anomalies"}```

oleg: KMS audit export shows a Decrypt event at 2025-11-02T14:23:13Z with correlated request_id=req_0a1b2c3d and key key_eu_0a1b. I'll add that JSON to the bundle.

maria: Storage side: S3 shows object version with DeleteMarker created at 2025-11-02T14:23:14Z and a delete-marker-version id v-xyz. I captured the version listing.

sophie: Assemble instructions for bundle: include files: api-ingress.json, worker-trace.log, s3-versions.json, kms-events.json, hsm-handshake.json, README.txt (narrative + redaction notes), and SHA256SUMS. Ensure bundle is stored in a customer-accessible, expiring secure object (signed URL valid 7 days).

alex: @incidents-bot create evidence-bundle ticket in secure-docs and tag legal?

incidents-bot: Created ticket SEC-2467 in secure-docs. ACL: internal + legal. Signed URL will be generated once bundle uploaded.

jordan: Customer asked whether the KMS Decrypt proves data was accessible at the time of deletion. Answer: Decrypt event shows a worker requested key material to reconstruct envelope; combined with worker logs and storage delete marker, that provides a strong chain. I'll word this carefully in the narrative.

maria: Packaging checklist done. Generating archive now. ETA 30m. I included SHA256SUMS and redaction notes.

oleg: Security note — before we share the bundle with the customer we need a short review by Security to confirm no internal hostnames or IPs remain. Will review now.

sophie: I'll do a quick redaction review within 1 hour. If approved, generate signed URL with 7 day expiry.

alex: Thanks team. Jordan I'll draft the customer message and attach the bundle once security signs off. Keep me posted if any legal flags.

maria: Bundle uploaded to secure-docs (SEC-2467). File: acme-deletion-bundle-20251102.tar.gz sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924... (truncated)

sophie: Security review completed. No secrets found. Approved to share.

incidents-bot: Signed URL generated: https://secure.redwood.internal/s/SEC-2467/acme-deletion-bundle-20251102?exp=7d  (internal link, share via customer portal only)

alex: Jordan, please send to customer with the README and timeline. Mark ticket resolved after they acknowledge. Great work. :thumbsup:

jordan: Will do. Draft sent, waiting for ack.

maria: Closing local worklog. If they ask for longer retention of logs, route to legal & security for a DPA addendum.

oleg: FYI we recorded no KMS/HSM anomalies during handshake — saved as evidence.

alex: Thread update: customer acknowledged receipt and said "this is perfect, thanks". Closing on our side.

sophie: Filing note: retention/packaging workflow updated in runbook (link: internal:/runbooks/gdpr-evidence-packaging).

alex: End of thread.
